title: Database Management and Development for Health Care Systems
description: Provides students with hands-on lab experience with SQL and a sophisticated, full-scale multi-platform database management system such as Oracle. Using a set of accompanying tools, students 1) explore the architecture of a database management system, 2) design a database, 3) implement a database, 4) maintain and administer a database, 5) manage application security and 6) develop prototypes of database applications. Students are able to transfer this experience to other database management systems.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of HINF 201, HINF 301.

items.text: admission to BSc in Health Information Science or Combined BSc in Health Information Science and Computer Science
